settings.title: System Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage site configuration, appearance preferences and runtime information.
settings.basicDesc: Site identity, default language and data retention policy.
settings.appearanceDesc: Theme, density and sidebar preferences, persisted locally.
settings.themeHelp: Switch between light/dark themes; Auto follows your operating system setting.
settings.densityHelp: Controls table row height, card padding and component compactness.
settings.sidebarHelp: When enabled, the sidebar collapses into icon mode and expands on hover.
settings.siteNameHelp: Displayed in the browser title bar and login page
settings.defaultLocaleHelp: The default language for new users on their first visit.
settings.logLevelHelp: Controls application log verbosity. debug is most verbose, error only logs errors.
settings.retentionHelp: How long execution records and logs are retained, range 7-365 days
settings.networkEnvironmentHelp: When isolated, alert notifications degrade to plain text with no external network dependency
settings.sessionTimeoutHelp: Auto logout after user inactivity, in minutes
settings.retentionRangeError: Retention days must be between 7 and 365
settings.sessionTimeoutRequired: Session timeout must be greater than 0

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.subtitle: Manage API access keys — create, view and revoke.
apiKeys.name: Key Name
apiKeys.rawKeyWarning: Copy and store your key now. It is shown only once and cannot be retrieved after closing.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmDesc: You are about to revoke key "{name}". It will be invalidated immediately and cannot be restored.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmTip: Type the key name to confirm the revoke.

info.title: System Info
info.subtitle: View runtime metadata, build information and configuration overview.
info.runtimeInfoDesc: Runtime metadata of the current instance (read-only).
